tagline: Internet ke networks ek doosre ko kaise batate hain ki kaun kahan rehta hai.
description: Internet lagbhag 75,000 alag networks se bana hai jinhe Autonomous Systems kehte hain. BGP woh tareeka hai jisse woh apne padosiyon ko batate hain ki woh kaunse address blocks tak pahunch sakte hain aur networks ki kaunsi chain ke through. Kisi website tak pahunchne ke liye tum jo bhi route use karte ho woh BGP se seekha gaya hota hai.
facts: Pehle policy, phir sabse chhota AS_PATH

normal.name: Do ISPs transit ke through route seekhte hain
normal.summary: ISP A apne transit provider ke saath BGP session up karta hai aur 203.0.113.0/24 announce karta hai; transit use ISP B ko aage pass karta hai.

steps.title: TCP session kholo
steps.desc: ISP A port 179 par transit se connect hota hai
steps.detail: BGP ki apni reliability nahi hoti. Yeh TCP par chalta hai, isliye kho gaye messages dobara bheje jate hain aur order mein aate hain. ISP A ke router mein transit ka address neighbour ke roop mein configured hai aur woh port 179 par connection kholta hai. IP TTL 1 hai kyunki external BGP neighbours aam taur par directly connected hote hain.

quiz.q: BGP har route sirf ek baar kyun bhej sakta hai, har kuch seconds mein dohrane ki jagah?
options: Routes kabhi nahi badalte
TCP guarantee karta hai ki har message pahunche
Routers routes disk par save karte hain
UDP itna tez hai ki dohra sakte hain
quiz.why: Kyunki TCP har byte reliably deliver karta hai, route tab hi bhejna padta hai jab woh badle. Isi wajah se BGP lagbhag ek million routes tak scale karta hai.

steps.title: OPEN badlo
steps.desc: Tum kaun ho, aur kya kar sakte ho?
steps.detail: Har router apne AS number, hold time, router ID aur capabilities ki list ke saath OPEN bhejta hai. Yahan dono sides IPv4 unicast routes, route refresh aur 4-byte AS numbers support karti hain. Agar AS number woh nahi hai jo dusri side ne configure kiya hai, to woh session turant reject kar deti hai.

quiz.q: ISP A 90 s hold time offer karta hai aur transit 180 s. Session kaunsa hold time use karta hai?
options: 135 s (average)
Har side apna use karti hai
quiz.why: Dono sides chhoti value leti hain, isliye session 90 s use karta hai. KEEPALIVEs phir aam taur par uska ek tihai, yaani 30 s par bheje jate hain.

steps.title: KEEPALIVE: Established
steps.desc: 19-byte ka message jo kehta hai “main agree hoon”
steps.detail: KEEPALIVE sirf type 4 wala 19-byte header hota hai. Pehla wala dusri side ke OPEN ko confirm karta hai. Dono aa jane par session Established state mein chala jata hai aur routes bah sakte hain.

steps.title: 203.0.113.0/24 announce karo
steps.desc: UPDATE: address ka yeh block mere paas rehta hai
steps.detail: ISP A apne address block ke liye UPDATE bhejta hai. Path attributes route ko describe karte hain: ORIGIN kehta hai ki yeh jaan-boojh kar announce hua, AS_PATH un networks ko list karta hai jinse woh guzra hai (abhi tak sirf 64500), aur NEXT_HOP batata hai ki traffic kahan bhejna hai. Prefix khud aakhir mein NLRI ke roop mein aata hai.

quiz.q: Transit yeh route ISP B ko aage pass karta hai. ISP B ko kaunsa AS_PATH dikhega?
quiz.why: Har AS route ko dusre AS ko bhejte waqt apna number aage jodta hai. ISP B ko 64496 64500 dikhta hai aur woh 64510 tabhi jodega jab route ko phir aage pass kare.

steps.title: ISP B ko aage pass karo
steps.desc: Transit apna AS aur apna next hop jodta hai
steps.detail: Transit ka ISP B ke saath session pehle se up hai. Woh route ko AS_PATH ke aage 64496 jodkar aur apna address NEXT_HOP banakar aage bhejta hai. ISP B use install karta hai, aur uske customers ab transit ke through 203.0.113.0/24 tak pahunch sakte hain.

quiz.q: Agar ISP B ko yeh route AS_PATH mein 64510 pehle se hone ke saath milta, to woh kya karta?
options: Use best route ke roop mein install karta
Reject karta, kyunki yeh loop hota
Transit ko wapas forward karta
Transit se refresh maangta
quiz.why: Apna hi AS number dikhne ka matlab hai ki route pehle hi uske through guzar chuka hai. Aise routes ko reject karna hi BGP networks ke beech loops rokta hai.

steps.title: Sampark mein raho
steps.detail: Kehne ko kuch naya na ho to routers bas KEEPALIVEs bhejte hain, yahan har 30 seconds mein (90 s hold time ka ek tihai). Agar 90 seconds tak kisi bhi tarah ka message nahi aata, to session tod diya jata hai aur uske through seekhe gaye saare routes hata diye jate hain.
facts: Sirf badalne par dobara bheje jate hain

outro.title: Route bahar hai
outro.text: Do routers ne TCP session banaya, OPEN se settings agree ki, KEEPALIVE se confirm kiya aur ek UPDATE mein route badla. Transit ne use apna AS jodkar aage pass kiya, aur isi tarah internet ka har network har dusre tak ka path seekhta hai.

hold-timer.name: Hold timer expire ho jata hai
hold-timer.summary: ISP A ka router freeze ho jata hai aur baat karna band kar deta hai. 90 seconds baad transit haar maan leta hai aur route withdraw kar deta hai.

steps.title: ISP A se chuppi
steps.desc: Transit bhejta rehta hai, wapas kuch nahi aata
steps.detail: ISP A ke router ka BGP process atak gaya hai: link up hai, lekin ab woh KEEPALIVEs nahi bhejta. Transit apne KEEPALIVEs har 30 seconds mein bhejta rehta hai aur apna hold timer ginna shuru karta hai.
facts: 90 s se ginti ghat rahi hai

steps.title: NOTIFICATION
steps.detail: 90 seconds tak kuch na milne par transit error code 4 ke saath NOTIFICATION bhejta hai aur TCP connection band kar deta hai. NOTIFICATION hamesha session khatam karta hai. ISP A se seekhe saare routes phenk diye jate hain.

quiz.q: Ab transit ki routing table mein 203.0.113.0/24 ka kya hota hai?
options: Jab tak koi delete na kare tab tak rehta hai
Hata diya jata hai, aur neighbours ko bata diya jata hai
24 ghante ke liye rakha jata hai
ISP B ke paas chala jata hai
quiz.why: Routes sirf utni der jeete hain jitni der unka session. Transit unhe hata deta hai aur apne dusre neighbours ko withdrawal se batata hai.

steps.title: Route withdraw karo
steps.detail: Transit ISP B ko aisa UPDATE bhejta hai jisme koi path attributes nahi, sirf ek withdrawn route. ISP B 203.0.113.0/24 hata deta hai. Agar ISP A ka doosra provider hota, to traffic ab us taraf se jata; sirf ek hone par web server tab tak unreachable hai jab tak session wapas nahi aata.

outro.title: Recover hone tak unreachable
outro.text: Hold timer woh tareeka hai jisse BGP us neighbour ko pakadta hai jo chupchap mar gaya. Iski keemat hai 90 seconds tak black-hole hota traffic, isliye kai networks BFD bhi chalate hain, ek chhota hello protocol jo failures ek second se kam mein detect karta hai.

hijack.name: Route hijack aur RPKI
hijack.summary: Bura network ISP A ke addresses ke liye zyada specific /25 announce karta hai; RPKI route origin validation ise rok deta hai.

steps.title: Ek jhootha announcement
steps.detail: Jo network in addresses ka maalik nahi woh 203.0.113.0/25 announce karta hai, jo ISP A ke block ka pehla aadha hissa hai. Aisa galti se hota hai (filter mein typo) ya jaan-boojh kar (traffic churane ke liye). BGP ke paas yeh check karne ka koi tareeka nahi ki address block ka maalik kaun hai.

quiz.q: Routers ab 203.0.113.0/24 via AS64500 aur 203.0.113.0/25 via AS64511 jaante hain. 203.0.113.10 ka traffic kahan jata hai?
options: AS64500, woh pehle se tha
AS64511, lamba prefix jeet jata hai
Dono ke beech barabar baant jata hai
Kahin nahi, routes conflict karte hain
quiz.why: Routers hamesha sabse specific matching prefix use karte hain. /25 /24 se zyada specific hai, isliye woh AS_PATH kitna bhi lamba ho tab bhi jeet jata hai.

steps.title: Checks ke bina: hijacked
steps.desc: Transit yakeen karke use phaila deta hai
steps.detail: Validation ke bina transit route accept karta hai aur ISP B ko pass kar deta hai. Laptop ka 203.0.113.10 ka connection ab AS64511 ki taraf jata hai, jo use drop kar sakta hai, padh sakta hai ya server banne ka natak kar sakta hai.

steps.title: Seekho kiska kya hai
steps.detail: ISP A ne ROA publish kiya hai, RPKI mein ek certificate-signed statement jo kehta hai “203.0.113.0/24, max length 24, sirf AS64500 originate kar sakta hai”. Ek validator saare ROAs download karke check karta hai aur results TCP 323 par RPKI-to-Router protocol se routers ko deta hai.

steps.title: Wahi attack, ab rejected
steps.desc: Route origin validation ise Invalid mark karta hai
steps.detail: AS64511 /25 phir announce karta hai. Transit use ROA se compare karta hai: origin AS galat hai aur /25 allowed max length se lamba hai, isliye route Invalid hai aur drop ho jata hai. Woh kabhi ISP B ko pass nahi hota.

quiz.q: Agar AS64511 uske bajaye 203.0.113.0/24 ko AS_PATH “64511 64500” ke saath announce karta, AS64500 ko origin ke roop mein fake karke?
options: ROV ise pakad leta
ROV ise Valid mark karta, kyunki sirf origin check hota hai
BGP duplicate prefix reject kar deta
ROA expire ho jata
quiz.why: ROV sirf path ka aakhri AS check karta hai. Origin fake karne se woh nikal jata hai, halanki route asli se lamba hota hai. BGPsec aur ASPA naye tools hain jo poora path check karte hain.

steps.title: Traffic ghar lautta hai
steps.detail: ISP B ko /25 ke baare mein kabhi pata nahi chalta, isliye laptop ka traffic transit ke through asli route se AS64500 tak jata hai aur asli web server tak pahunchta hai.

outro.title: Hijack block ho gaya
outro.text: BGP wahi maanta hai jo neighbours kehte hain, isliye ek galat announcement duniya bhar ka traffic kheench sakta hai. RPKI address owners ko sign karne deta hai ki unke prefixes kaun originate kar sakta hai, aur route origin validation un rules ko todne wale announcements drop kar deta hai.

cheatsheet.title: Message types
items: Session shuru karo: AS, hold time, router ID, capabilities
Fatal error, session band hota hai
Main zinda hoon / main tumhara OPEN accept karta hoon

cheatsheet.title: Path attributes
items: Neighbour ko hint ki kaunsi entry use kare
